notifications/sse.test.ts skipIf(!RUN_INTEGRATION) is pre-existing and outside this diff. It is not treated as coverage of the SSE 400. The three non-integration cases in that file passed unmodified, and the new characterization tests cover the deliverable.

Tests pin the 400 body with toEqual({ error: "workspaceId must be an integer" }), assert JSON content-type and absence of text/event-stream and Cache-Control no-cache, and fanOut after "abc"/"1.5" to prove no client was registered. Shutdown-then-invalid expects 400 not 503. "1e2" and "0" use raw http.get, destroy the request, call shutdown(), and time out at 1500ms so supertest never waits on the open stream.

Installed worktree packages: zod 4.4.3 (server/package.json ^4.4.3) and express 5.2.1 (server/package.json ^5.1.0). parseWith(legacyIntegerParam(...)) on those versions returns exactly { error: "workspaceId must be an integer" } for "abc" and "1.5", and accepts "1e2" as 100 and "0" as 0, matching Number.isInteger(Number(raw)). workspaceIdParam rejects both "1e2" and "0", so the lenient helper is required. schemas.test.ts pins the same contract.
